title: Combined Shipping Across FilterDirect Subscriptions
content:
Combined shipping applies to every grade of FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions. Where combined shipping applies, the shipments of all of a customer's active subscriptions that leave on the same ship date travel in one box: their shipment charges are added together against the free-shipping threshold, and at most one shipping fee is charged for that date, on the subscription with the earliest sign-up date. Only one shipping fee is charged per ship date across a customer's subscriptions.

| Grade | Combined shipping | Shipping fee, per shipment below the threshold | Free-shipping threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | Yes | $5.99 | $35.00 |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | Yes | $5.99 | $35.00 |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | Yes | $5.99 | $35.00 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | Yes | $5.99 | $35.00 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | Yes | $5.99 | $35.00 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | Yes | $5.99 | $35.00 |

The free-shipping threshold is the shipment charge at or above which shipping is free; the shipping fee of $5.99 is the fee for a shipment below that threshold.

### What the records show

Whether a shipping fee has already been charged for a ship date is read from the company's charge records, not from the customer's account of it: the shipping fee entries posted for the same customer on the same date, across all of that customer's subscriptions. One such entry for the customer and the date is the one shipping fee that date can carry.

### Reading the rule

- **Who is grouped.** The customer's active subscriptions whose shipments leave on the same ship date.
- **What is compared.** The total of those subscriptions' shipment charges, against $35.00.
- **How many fees.** At most one shipping fee of $5.99 for the date.
- **Where the fee sits.** On the subscription with the earliest sign-up date among them.

### Worked cases (hypothetical amounts)

**Case A.** Two active subscriptions of one customer ship on the same date, with hypothetical shipment charges of $20.00 on the subscription signed up first and $10.00 on the later one. Together they total $30.00, below $35.00, so one shipping fee of $5.99 is charged for the date, on the subscription signed up first; the later subscription carries no shipping fee that date.

**Case B.** The same two subscriptions with hypothetical shipment charges of $20.00 and $18.00 total $38.00, at or above $35.00, so shipping is free for that date and no shipping fee is charged.

**Case C (on the boundary).** Hypothetical shipment charges of $17.50 and $17.50 total exactly $35.00; the total is at the threshold, so shipping is free.

**Case D.** A shipping fee entry already stands for the customer on a ship date. No second shipping fee is charged for that date on any of the customer's subscriptions.
